thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx + gateway timeouts in prod us-west-2. Services implicated: gateway-proxy -> scheduler-v2 -> batch-assembly. Trigger: error_rate(5xx) > 4% over 4m and gateway 504s increasing. Paging oncall.
anya (oncall): picked up. grabbing dashboards and which customers are impacted. Dan, can you summarize queue metrics?
dan (sre): queue_head moved from ~150 to ~6.4k in ~3m on scheduler-v2. head-of-line blocking observed: many small-seq chats queuing for long assembly times. batcher concurrency at 100% for shard-5.
sophia (runtime): seeing high KV cache pinning on hot keys and long assembly latency for small-seq because max_batch_wait is still 200ms for these routes. KV memory bumping per-shard causing slower eviction.
anya (oncall): immediate plan: 1) open emergency admission control to reduce allowed in-flight small requests, 2) force-evict low-priority queues, 3) reduce per-route max_batch_wait to 50ms for chat_small, 4) enable gateway circuit-breaker to fail-fast for non-urgent routes. We'll also update status page.
infra-bot: Running command: `admitctl set --service=scheduler-v2 --route=chat_small --admit_rate=0.6` -> accepted.
anya (oncall): dan, run eviction script for priority=bulk and kick off transient workers if available.
dan (sre): evicting bulk and background queues now. snippet: ```
redwood-queue ps --env=prod --filter=priority:bulk | xargs -I{} redwood-queue evict --queue {} --reason "emergency-evict-5xx"
```
liz (support): I'm drafting a short status: "We're investigating increased timeouts and error rates in US-West affecting some inference requests. We're taking mitigations to reduce impact and will post updates every 15 minutes." Who do we notify directly?
anya (oncall): send to accounts with >50 RPS and to any active enterprise incidents. mark status as partial outage for us-west-2.
ryan (eng-lead): suggest we temporarily route traffic from low-cost fallback model (chat_small_slim) for all non-authenticated dev-tier traffic — that buys us headroom. Sophia can you add a routing rule?
sophia (runtime): applying quick route: `route set --from=chat_small --to=chat_small_slim --match=client_tier:dev --pct=100 --region=us-west-2` -> done.
dan (sre): note: autoscaler refused +3 due to policy quota. infra ticket opened for quota increase: TICKET-7892.
anya (oncall): as backup we'll reduce memory pressure: sophia, can you lower kv cache TTL on hot shard(s) and nuke expired keys?
sophia (runtime): doing TTL change on shard-5/6: `kvctl set-ttl --shard=5 --ttl=45s` and `kvctl trim --hotkeys=top50` - running.
(10m later)
dan (sre): metrics after admission/evict/ttl: queue_head ~1.2k, p95 latency dropped from 5.9s to 2.0s, 5xx rate now ~1.8%. Gateway 504s reduced but still present for older sessions.
anya (oncall): good progress. who wants to take handoff? I have another pager in 20m. Dan, can you take incident lead?
dan (sre): I can take it. I'll keep watch for 30-60m and coordinate infra quota. Also will schedule a controlled restart plan for batcher shard-5 if eviction and TTL don't continue to improve.
liz (support): sending update to affected customers with brief mitigation summary and expected next update in 30m.
ryan (eng-lead): for postmortem hypothesis: load pattern shows a sudden influx of low-infer-length parallel requests (likely a client-side fanout). Admission controls and batcher admission thresholds didn't reduce inflow early. Also autoscaler quota prevented rapid horizontal scale. Action items: add early queue-depth alert at 500 sustained for 3m, tune default max_batch_wait for chat_small to 50ms, and add automatic fallback routing rule when queue depth > 1k.
sophia (runtime): I'll run a safe experiment to lower default max_batch_wait and add a conservative admission-rate controller. Create follow-up PR for rollout.
dan (sre): logs show repeated errors: ```
2026-06-05T02:12:14Z scheduler-v2[pid=4432]: dispatch_wait_exceeded: waited=150s head=6402
2026-06-05T02:12:14Z gateway-proxy[pid=2219]: upstream_timeout: scheduler-v2
```
anya (oncall): marking incident "mitigating". Dan taking lead. I'll post handoff notes to #oncall-handoffs and #status-incidents.
infra-bot: Incident captured: INC-20260605-CHASM. Timeline recorded.
(25m later)
dan (sre): observed stabilization for 12m. queue_head fluctuating 800-1.1k. I set a temporary alert: queue_depth > 1k for 5m -> page SRE. Created follow-up tickets: TICKET-7910 (postmortem), TICKET-7911 (quota request), TICKET-7912 (runbook edits).
anya (oncall): thanks team. i'll follow up on customer comms cadence. good job. :thumbsup:
